input.requirement: getType must treat every line terminator (U+000A, U+000D, U+2028, U+2029) like any other character when stripping the directory part and the extension prefix, so filenames containing line terminators still derive the correct type from the extension after the last dot.
input.why: Without the fix, the two regexes /^.*[/\\]/ and /^.*\./ don't match across line terminators (since . doesn't match \n, \r, U+2028, U+2029 by default). This causes getType to fail to strip either the directory part or the extension prefix correctly when the filename contains a line terminator, resulting in incorrect lookup that yields null. With the fix (using [\s\S] or similar pattern instead of .), all four line terminators are treated like any other character and the correct 'image/png' type is derived from the .png extension. The cases with normal.txt and a/b.png verify that existing behavior for inputs without line terminators still works.
